tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ༁ྃ: zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig las: tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus kyi lo rgyus bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'chi med dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra mtsho skyes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas thugs las brtol: 'o ma can mtshor rang byung sprul skur bltams: o rgyan rgyal po'i sras mdzad rgyal srid bskyangs: mā ra ti kar 'chi med rig 'dzin thob: dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs spyod pa bstan: rdo rje gdan du bstan pa'i so nams byas: smon lam dbang gis bod yul dbus su 'ong: mnga' bdag rgyal po'i dgongs pa yongs su bsgrubs: gtsug lag sa btul rab gnas mnga' gsol byas: rgya chos bod bsgyur bod yul mun gling du: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar: de tshe mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan nyid: bod yul mi lo sum stong bzhugs pa'i phyir: pur rgyal bod yul brag dmar g.ya' ma yi: rang byung gsang ba'i phug par 'chi med bsgrubs: tshe lhas zhal bstan dkyil 'khor bkrag dang ldan: tshe chu khol zhing lung pa sman dris khengs: de tshe dpal gyi mi 'gyur bsam yas nas: rgyal po dbang zhur gnas 'dir chas pa las: dmar rgyan klu gong klu dpal bshol 'debs kyis: bar chad dbang song rten 'brel 'grigs ma gyur: de nas bai ro mtsho rgyal gsol 'debs ltar: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub thabs zab mo dang: tshe chu rgyun dang ril bur dril nas kyang: lung bzhin bod yul khyab pa'i gter du sbas: phyi ma skal ldan don byed smon lam btab: khyad par 'chi med yang snying 'dus pa yi: sgrub thabs chig dril lo chen nyid la gnang: de tshe lo tsā bai ro tsa na yis: slob dpon nyid la da lta spel bya 'am: ma 'ongs don du gter du sba zhus pas: slob dpon gsungs nas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus: ngas bshad rgya che'i chos rnams nyams mi lon: de phyir tshig nyung don 'dril gdams pa 'di: pha bong stag nyal 'dra ba'i brag la sbos: bdag dang lo chen smon lam mtha' btsan pas: ma 'ongs 'gro phan rgya chen 'byung bar 'gyur:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin yi ger btab ste: ma 'ongs pa'i don du gter du sbas pa: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim:1$0000250 rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000300༈ zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig las: 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: 'chi med dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha was: phyi rabs don du snying po'i gter ji snyed: sbas pa'i nang nas mchog gyur gdams pa 'di: las ldan snying gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: 'chi med gdams pa yang snying kun 'dus las: yang gsang spyi dril sgrub pa bya 'dod na: dben zhing nyams dga'i sa gzhi gtsang ma ru: 'jam mkhregs sa la maṇ+ḍal khru gang bya: de nas 'dab brgyad dkyil 'khor mdzes par bri: de dbus rin chen bum pa mtshan ldan ni: dri bzang chus bkrus bkra shis rdzas kyis bkang: kha rgyan mgul chings dag gis legs par brgyan: gzhan yang mtshan ldan thod pa bdud rtsi dang: gtor ma tshe ril srog rten mda' dar dang: phyi nang mchod sprin ma lus tshang bar bsham: skyabs 'gro ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'chi med lha tshogs thugs rje can: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha rnams la: tshe yi rig 'dzin ma thob bar: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni: hrī: bdag gzhan 'chi med thob bya'i phyir: tshe yi lha tshogs bsgrub nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: hrī: mi dmigs gsal ba'i ngang nyid las: skad cig rig pa hūm̐ du bsgom: de las 'od 'phros phyogs mtshams kun: rdo rje'i gur khang chen por gyur: badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: hrī: de dbus pho brang gzhal yas khang: yid 'ong lte bar pad nyi'i steng: hrīḥlas rang nyid tshe dpag med: dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin:

longs sku'i rgyan spras skyil krung bzhugs: phyi rol 'dab brgyad pad+ma'i steng: sems ma bzhi dang mgyogs ma bzhi: phyi rol sgo ma bzhi la sogs: 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren ni: hrī: bde chen rnam par dag pa'i klong yangs nas: bcom ldan lha mchog mgon po tshe dpag med: 'khor bcas ma lus thugs rje'i dbang gis ni: 'dir gshegs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsol 'debs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings phyogs lhung bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du: snang ba mtha' yas 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'od gsal rang shar rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: tshe dpag med mgon 'chi med= gsol ba= 'gal rkyen= oṃ āḥhūm̐: pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du: o rgyan pad+ma 'chi med= gsol ba= 'gal rkyen= oṃ āḥhūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag la: gsol ba= 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol: badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: mchod pa byin rlabs ni: phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa'i sprin: zag med nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan phyi mchod 'bul: sha khrag ba liṃ a mṛ ta: thod rnga la sogs nang mchod 'bul: gnyis med mnyam sbyor byang sems sogs: gsang ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: sarba ma hā pū dza ho: bstod pa ni: hrī: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung rang shar ba'i: mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sems ma bzhi dang mgyogs ma chen mo bzhi: sgo srung bzhi sogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: bzlas pa ni: rang gi thugs kar 'dab brgyad zla steng hrī:

mtha' skor sngags phreng dmar gsal g.yas skor du: rang sgras 'khor zhing hrīḥlas 'od zer ni: lcags kyu ltar 'phros tshe srog dpal 'byor kun: 'ub bsdus bdag thim rdo rje'i skur gyur te: snang la rang bzhin med bsgom bzlas pa bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ mdun rten rnams las 'od 'phros bdag la thim: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas mi dmigs spros bral chos dbyings ngang: lhod kyis glod pas sku gsum lhun gyis grub: badz+ra mu: 'bum tsho gsum du bsnyen pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: khri tsho gcig gis rig 'dzin 'grub: stong tsho gcig gis 'gal rkyen sel: zhes so: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus kyi: yang gsang spyi dril sgrub pa 'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: :1$0000250 rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000300༈ zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig las: tshe sgrub kyi rjes gnang zab mo bzhugs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'chi med lha la phyag 'tshal lo: tshe sgrub kyi mtha' rten du dbang blang ba ni: dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag btsal te gsol ba gdab pa: kye: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: bde gshegs rigs 'dus 'chi med lha'i: byin rlabs dbang bskur bstsal du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur bar bsam nas gtor ma spyi bor blangs la: hrī: rigs 'dus bde gshegs 'chi med lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas brtser dgongs skal ldan bu rnams la: 'chi med byin rlabs tshe yi dbang bskur te: mi g.yo rdo rje gsum dang ldan par shog: gu ru ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: thod pa mgrin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi lce thog tu myang la: ā: 'chi med bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta:

rtsa brgyad lo 'dab stong las sbyar ba'i sman: 'thungs pas 'tsho ba'i yid bzhin rdzas mchog 'di: myang bas ā yuḥtshe yi dbang thob shog: gu ru ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tshe ril myang la: hrī: rdo rje'i bcud ldan 'chi med thabs kyi rdzas: 'dod yon mi zad 'od zer sna lnga 'phro: reg myang rdo rje'i sku 'grub rdzas mchog 'di: myang bas 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: gu ru ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mda' dar lus la reg la: hrī: 'chi med srog rten ye shes lnga dang ldan: bde gshegs rgyal bas byin brlabs nus ldan 'dis: reg pas mi mthun ma lus zhi ba dang: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob par shog: ces blang ngo: sa ma ya:1$0000250 rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000300༈ tshe 'khor bca' thabs: 'chi med dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: tshe 'khor bca' bar 'dod pa la: gro ga dar dmar rgya shog la: rin chen lnga dang mtshal dag gis: tshe lha'i sku bris lto ba ru: mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor: de yi nang du pad 'dab brgyad: lte bar mu khyud gcig bcas bri: dbus su gsang sngags 'di nyid bri: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes mthar ming spel sham bu gdags: mu khyud dag la rtsa sngags ni: gang shong g.yas skor dag tu bri: 'dab ma brgyad la ā yu ṣe: sham bu can du bri bar bya: mu khyud dang por 'dod don gsol: gnyis par dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying: gsum par rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor: lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas kyis byug: bkra shis yar ngo'i dus kyi tshe: ye shes bstim zhing rab gnas bya: gang gi mgul du btags pa na: tshe 'phel nad gdon ma lus zhi: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par byed: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:1$0000250 rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o/// /

1$0000300༈ bcud len gyi gdams pa: 'chi med dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: tshe dang dpal 'byor spel ba'i phyir: bcud len gdams pa bya 'dod na: cong zhi sa rdul ma 'dres pa: 'dul sbyong dang ldan steng du ni: brag zhun lug ru a wa dang: lnga tshan lnga ni tshogs par sbyar: sbrang dang sbyar la ril bu ni: bra ril nyi shu'i tshad du dril: mtshan ldan thod par dar dmar blug: ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs te: lhar gsal 'o ma'i rta la bskyon: rgyun du bsten par byas gyur na: tshe ring rgas sra don kun 'grub: dam can kun 'du dngos grub thob: yang zab bcud len gdams pa 'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:1$0000250 rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000300༈ za yig gi gdams pa zab mo: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'chi med dbang gi lha la 'dud: 'gal rkyen ma lus sel byed dang: khyad par tshe ring 'dod pa na: za yig 'di nyid brten par bya: gro ga shing shun rgya shog la: yi ge 'di nyid bris byas te: rin chen lnga dang dri bzang dang: sman lnga dag gis legs par byugs: rgyu skar rgyal la rab gnas bya: rgyun du brten na tshe 'phel zhing: 'gal rkyen ma lus sel bar 'gyur: zab mo yi ge'i gdams pa 'o: : zhes slob dpon gyis gsungs bzhin lo tsā ba bdag gis yi ge'i ris su bkod de: ma 'ongs pa'i don du gter du sbas pas: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: bka' rgya: gsang rgya: smrag kha thaṃ: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ1$0000250 rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pas brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas spyan drangs pa'o// //1$0000300
